notes.title: Release Notes
notes.content:
Live Inc. has come out of early access!
This patch focuses on changes in audio and balancing based on your feedback.

- Removed the loud alarm sound, hacker and admin will need to communicate to status of the timer to their teammates.
- Triggered sensors will now only give a sound notification to the Admin.
- The game now starts with some sensors enabled for increased decision making.
- Resetting a server will now reduce the timer a lot more.
- Adjusted the movement speed and movement sounds for the Spy and the Guard.
- Other minor audio changes
- Updated the tutorial content
- Minor HUD changes

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0
notes.content:
In this patch we fixed some game-breaking issues and polished some of our features. We also updated the art on the outside of the level.

- Fixed issue where you would sometimes fall through the map
- Fixed bug where spy objectives wouldn't spawn correctly
- Added new models outside the building
- Lighting improvements

Thank you all for playing and leaving feedback!
There will be another update later this week.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.content: In our first patch we fixed a major issue that caused the players to restart the application after a game had ended. Now players will return to the lobby as intended.
